title_vi: Tầm quan trọng của việc phải là Ernest
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The epigrams are rendered as speakable Vietnamese with Wilde’s paradox structure and deadpan register kept; Lady Bracknell keeps an imperious ‘bà/tôi’, Lane a laconic ‘thưa ngài’.
decisions.rationale: The play’s effect depends on timing and class voice, not on word-for-word equivalence.

decisions.decision: Character names are kept in their English form; speech labels stay as upper-case labels at the head of each unit; stage directions stay in square brackets.
decisions.rationale: A stage text needs recognisable speakers and a stable apparatus.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The Ernest/earnest hook was weak; the pun is now carried through ‘Ernest nhất—tức là nghiêm chỉnh nhất’ and the closing line.
‘dưới xe ngựa’ read as ‘under the carriage’; the carriage idiom and the dog-cart (‘xe hai bánh’) were corrected.
Cecily–Jack address changed from ‘bác Jack’ to ‘chú Jack’ so the play uses one system; units 785, 715 and 844 also corrected.
The closing line was shortened so the pun is played rather than glossed.
A garbled line about Mr. Worthing, ‘thủy tùng’ for yew and other small naturalness points were corrected.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The pun of the title: the name Ernest is kept and the adjective is rendered ‘nghiêm chỉnh’ so that the closing line lets both senses collide.
Algernon’s fictitious invalid; the name is kept and the verb is formed from it.

glossary.source_term: Aunt Augusta / Cecily and Jack (ward and guardian)
glossary.rationale: One address system through the play: Algernon says ‘dì’ to Lady Bracknell; Cecily calls Jack ‘chú’ and he calls her ‘cháu’.
One rendering for the country house in Acts II and III.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #844, an electronic text of the three-act version of The Importance of Being Earnest, first performed at the St James’s Theatre on 14 February 1895. Not collated with the 1895 or 1899 printed editions.

unresolved_questions.explanation: A few period terms (for example the glossed income-tax joke) are explained more than a stage line would allow.

title_review.target_title: Tầm quan trọng của việc phải là Ernest
title_review.rationale: The Vietnamese title is this edition’s own rendering built on the name Ernest, with the pun on ‘earnest’ carried by ‘nghiêm chỉnh’ in the text itself.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The opening exchange between Algernon and Lane.
The closing line on the importance of being Ernest.
